profile.title: Platform & DevOps Engineer
profile.metaDescription: Jyothi Siddalingappa Jayanna is a platform and DevOps engineer in Chemnitz, studying Web Engineering and experienced with Kubernetes, Azure, Java, and Spring Boot.
profile.status: Immediately available for Werkstudent roles · up to 20 hours/week
profile.heroRole: Building reliable platforms, cloud infrastructure, and backend services.
profile.heroSub: M.Sc. Web Engineering student at TU Chemnitz with 3+ years of experience at A.P. Moller–Maersk. I build with Java, Spring Boot, Kubernetes, and Azure, and have delivered internal platform tooling used by 8,000+ engineers.

paragraphs: I’m a platform and DevOps engineer with more than three years of professional experience building backend workflows and developer tooling at A.P. Moller–Maersk. My work spans Java and Spring Boot services, Temporal workflows, Kubernetes on Azure, and CI/CD automation.

I’m currently pursuing an M.Sc. in Web Engineering at TU Chemnitz. I enjoy making complex engineering workflows easier for teams, supporting production systems, and helping engineers get started with confidence.

experience.title: Platform engineering grounded in production experience.
experience.subtitle: From building workflows and integrations for an internal developer platform to sharing cloud and software engineering knowledge through workshops.

highlights: Built Java, Spring Boot, and Temporal backend workflows for deployment validation and service onboarding on an internal platform used by 8,000+ engineers.
Independently delivered a Temporal deletion workflow in one month to remove service integrations, associated data, and Kubernetes resources.
Built a Maersk Application Catalog integration to register services and a GitHub integration that creates repositories, applies custom properties, and configures CI from templates.
Co-maintained MTTS, synchronizing teams across Azure, GitHub, and the organization’s team space.
Automated CI/CD pipeline scaffolding and operated Azure Kubernetes clusters, troubleshooting Helm releases and rollouts.
Co-maintained CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Supported deployment, upgrades, maintenance, and day-to-day operation of Harbor and SonarQube in Kubernetes clusters.
Created an ARM-based GitHub self-hosted runner and partnered on the organization’s migration from Azure DevOps to GitHub.
Resolved 1,000+ Level 2/3 incidents, wrote Python automation for operations and integration testing, and received the Maersk SPOT Award.
Led onboarding sessions twice a month for new team members.
Supported CI/CD pipelines, deployments, monitoring checks, and production incident triage using Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure DevOps.
Advanced from Alpha to Beta milestone and conducted 15+ technical workshops on Java, web development, and cloud computing.
Completed hands-on Azure assignments and received the Best Mentor award.

items.title: LogLens: AI-Powered Log Diagnosis & Learning
items.description: A completed, language-agnostic log analysis tool for logs from any programming language or technology stack. LogLens identifies likely root causes, explains what went wrong, and provides practical solutions alongside relevant videos and links to help anyone understand and learn from the issue. It combines rule-based detection with a local Ollama LLM; logs stay on-device and secrets are redacted before analysis.
